BASED IN NIGERIA / OPEN TO WORK WORLDWIDE

Odusina Isaac.

Making the difference
visible.

I’m Odusina Isaac Imoleayo, a brand and visual designer working across identity, packaging, campaigns and digital design.

My work starts with a question: what makes this business different? I use that understanding to develop a visual identity that feels specific to the brand and consistent across the things people see, hold and use.

This portfolio brings together identity systems for construction, beauty, education and community organisations, alongside food and beverage packaging and campaign communication.

I’m open to working with founders, businesses and creative teams worldwide, from a focused design brief to a connected set of brand applications.

HOW I WORK

Every detail follows.

01

02

04
